test_title: PYST 5: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'BORDER' is coded as ESUHHV and 'GLOBAL' is coded as JPRFDP. How will 'LATEST' be coded in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa6f5ee6331553c83733ca637f1f10facee1eca2d959ab9a6c583e6a3c26e995.png] 

'BORDER' is coded as 'ESUHHV' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be9e283afb18db70793800975ae2db3a3d3ecbd0dace1842816f7aded9c9d22e.png] 

'GLOBAL' is coded as 'JPRFDP' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ccdf5a217edd0329bb0dc54f58915482cfa1caa7749853a0f27234163ea2700.png] 

Similarly, 'LATEST' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21bb55b55e43fe4ad550dad05320f2602511e6e4b916aed3fcffc69a4286b023.png] 

Here, 'LATEST' is written as **'OEWIVX'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
